note: Two workload_dependency edges come from the family's two production-positive pairs: source -> target and multi-source -> multi-target. Every endpoint owns exactly one current-generation Kubernetes-Deployment workload, so the repo_dependency runner's automatic workload replay admits both pairs with evidence_source finalization/workloads. The orphan pair remains absent because neither endpoint is a current repo, so production's source-or-target-anchored lookup cannot return it to reconciliation. batchCanonicalWorkloadDependencyUpsertCypher keys each relationship by identity_key=canonical so concurrent source- and target-scope writers converge on one stored edge.
